snippet.title: MOTORSLICE ► Official Console and Release Month Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Alongside expert Slicer "P", parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every piece of construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure with immaculate vibes. MOTORSLICE launches on PC, Xbox, and PS5 this May.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830030/MOTORSLICE/
